I order from this app a lot and the most frustrating thing is every item sellar is now claiming local Warehouse. The seller is registered as a "local seller," but they don't actually hold inventory in the US. When you buy the item, the seller triggers a bulk shipment from China to a US hub first. Once it lands in the US and clears customs, a domestic carrier (like USPS or FedEx) prints a local label. That is why it says "Local" but takes 1 to 2 weeks to arrive.
